rule: SMB Cash-secured put campaign: 21d, delta 0.3, width 0%, PT 0%
description: SMB cash-secured puts / the wheel entry leg [batch-1 chapter]: sell a ~30-delta put (bear-market ladders go as low as 10-delta), collect the premium, settle at expiry - assignment risk IS the trade; risk = strike minus credit (cash-secured). Parameters here: 21 trading days, short-leg delta 0.3, width 0%, profit-take 0% (all editable via --smb-dte/--smb-delta/--smb-width-pct/--smb-profit-take-pct). Continuous campaign: a new cycle opens at the close whenever flat. r = cycle P&L / max risk; 1% of equity per cycle.
note: BSM-priced from our quote history; expiry settles intrinsic; NOT modeled: early assignment, dividends, vol smile, intraday management, earnings-date and 0DTE/intraday SMB strategies (need event/intraday data - disclosed out of scope).
